description:
You are a personal financial advisor managing a client's equity portfolio. After strong technology sector gains in late 2023, the portfolio has become severely overweight in tech stocks (approximately 78% allocation versus the client's Investment Policy Statement target of 45% tech / 30% healthcare / 25% energy). The client has instructed you to rebalance immediately.

The portfolio currently holds:
- AAPL (Apple Inc.): 150 shares, purchased Jan 2, 2024 @ $185.64
- MSFT (Microsoft): 80 shares, purchased Jan 2, 2024 @ $374.51
- NVDA (NVIDIA): 35 shares, purchased Jan 2, 2024 @ $495.22
- JNJ (Johnson & Johnson): 40 shares, purchased Jan 2, 2024 @ $152.10
- XOM (ExxonMobil): 60 shares, purchased Jan 2, 2024 @ $99.64

Using current market prices from February 15, 2024, execute the following rebalancing transactions in JStock's Portfolio Management section:

SELL transactions (all dated February 15, 2024, broker fee $6.95 each):
- Sell 45 shares of AAPL at $184.15 per share
- Sell 12 shares of NVDA at $674.72 per share

BUY transactions (all dated February 15, 2024, broker fee $6.95 each):
- Buy 35 additional shares of JNJ at $159.54 per share
- Buy 55 additional shares of XOM at $103.87 per share

After recording all four transactions, export the sell portfolio as a CSV file and save it to /home/ga/Desktop/rebalance_sells_feb2024.csv

Note: Real historical prices sourced from Yahoo Finance (finance.yahoo.com) for February 15, 2024 closing prices.
